name: Rocket Catch
detailed_description:
"Rocket Catch" - Official Steam Description

"Rocket Catch" is a game where you must expertly catch rocket parts that have separated in space as they return to Earth. This game demands extremely challenging maneuvers that mirror real-life rocket recovery operations. Can you successfully adjust the rocket boost angle and power while managing fuel consumption to safely catch the rocket parts on the landing pad?

Key Features:

  • Simple Yet Deep Gameplay: Easy controls that only require adjusting the direction and power of the rocket's jet propulsion.

  • Physics-Based Authentic Simulation: Realistic gravity and inertia effects on rocket parts provide a fresh playing experience every time.

  • Progressive Difficulty Levels: Difficulty varies significantly depending on fuel type. Can you clear the game with the Hard fuel "Olive Oil"?

How to Play:

At the title screen, change the difficulty level and press Enter to start.

The basic controls are very simple. Use the arrow keys (or WASD) to adjust the jet angle and power, guiding your rocket toward the landing pad on the ground. However, rockets are fragile! They will explode upon contact with the ground or launch pad. Skillfully control the jets to reach the landing pad.

When you reach the landing pad, a "Hold Space" message will appear. Press and hold the Space key to prepare for catching the rocket. When the gauge reaches maximum, the catch sequence begins. During this time, you must maintain the rocket's position. Your assistance is essential for the rocket parts to be successfully secured on the ground.

While these maneuvers are extremely challenging, we believe you can do it!

About the Developer:

GAIBAKO is a company passionate about creating fun and quirky games. We also develop various mobile games, so please check those out as well!

short_description: We demand extremely challenging maneuvers from you. In Rocket Catch, you must catch rocket parts that have been detached mid-air at the ground base. Can you successfully return the rocket parts safely to the ground by controlling the sensitive rocket boost and the sluggish catching platform?
